description: Audit-lane owned registry for Tier-A accepted non-axiom premise handling. Genuine admitted inputs are three: P1, S, and theta. Only two are machine premise nodes here because S is pervasive and has no single claim_id; it is tracked under not_a_node. AC_phi_lambda was retired on 2026-05-26 after the multi-witness convergence capstone (PR #1965) plus the four upstream science PRs (#1959, #1960, #1961, #1963) landed retained AND the user ratified C_b convention adoption (PR #1964); see retired_targets below for the closure record. Derivation targets are accepted as chain-satisfying premises at the bounded tier, so a clean row depending on one resolves to retained_bounded rather than retained_pending_chain; when a target is derived, remove its entry and compute_effective_status will auto-cascade dependents toward unbounded retained status when otherwise eligible. Y0 and g0 are vacuous rescaling conventions listed for survey completeness only: not admitted inputs, not derivation targets, not accepted premises, and not status-bounding dependencies. This registry is distinct from axiom_premise_nodes.json and from standard textbook theorems, which must earn retained-grade inline. Human-readable registry: docs/ADMITTED_INPUT_REGISTRY_TIER_A_NOTE_2026-05-23.md.

staggered_dirac_realization_gate_note_20.label: AC_phi_lambda
staggered_dirac_realization_gate_note_20.retirement_basis: multi_witness_convergence_capstone_theorem_note_2026-05-26 (PR #1965) + upstream science PRs #1959 (lattice WZ-Fujikawa internal ABJ on Z^4), #1960 (anomaly-forces-time v2), #1961 (Z_N equivariant spectral asymmetry on Cl(3)/Z^3), #1963 (AFT-mediated anomaly-inheritance translation lemma) all landed retained; PR #1964 ratified C_b as a retained governance convention (period-1 angular unit on C_N orbits, sibling to lattice-spacing/meter/GeV). Under C_b retention, the dimensionless invariant (N-1)/N^2 is read literally as delta_Brannen rad on the C_N orbit: 2/9 rad at N=3 (matches PDG to 7e-6, lepton Koide phase) and 5/36 rad at N=6 (matches retained CKM eta^2, quark sector). Single convention, both sectors, no per-sector parameter.

pillars_closed.abstract_sector_to_physical_species_brid: Already retained via graph_first_su3_integration_note (retained, fanin 64, transitive 1049) + lhcm_matter_assignment_from_su3_representation_note_2026-05-02 (decoration_under_graph_first_su3_integration_note) + lhcm_matter_assignment_su3_block_representation_narrow_theorem_note_2026-05-17 (retained_bounded). The color-charged-quark, color-singlet-lepton identification is SM-definition convention.
pillars_closed.cross_sector_mass_basis_alignment: Covered by retained CKM authorities (ckm_gate_closed_2026-04-25 + ckm_cp_phase_structural_identity_narrow_theorem_note_2026-05-10 retained + ckm_inverse_square_structural_sum_rule_narrow_theorem_note_2026-05-10 retained + ckm_atlas_closure_formula_algebra_narrow_theorem_note_2026-05-10 retained_pending_chain) and retained PMNS chain (pmns_oriented_cycle_channel_value_law_note retained, plus retained companion narrows). The capstone's single-convention cross-sector empirical match (N=3 lepton + N=6 quark from one C_b choice) is the structural alignment statement.

staggered_dirac_realization_gate_note_20.former_no_go_portfolio_status: Not retracted. The three no-gos (koide_a1_radian_bridge_irreducibility_audit_2026-04-24, koide_delta_lattice_wilson_selected_eigenline_no_go_2026-04-24, koide_delta_marked_relative_cobordism_no_go_2026-04-24) remain retained_no_go on their respective convention surfaces (period-2pi continuum). The capstone operates on a different convention surface (C_b period-1 angular unit on C_N orbits) and does not violate them. Both no-gos and capstone coexist as retained surfaces on different conventions; the registry retirement reflects that AC_phi_lambda is no longer a Tier-A admission, not that the no-gos were wrong on their own surface.
